categories.name: RF Cables and Accessories
categories.definition:
The cable category is basically divided into followings:
1. Feeder Cable – It is used to connect the radio with the antennas and is the long run of cable that is attached to the tower to transmit power.
2. Jumper Cable – It is used to connect the feeder cable to radio kit at one end and the antennas at the other end
3. Connectors – Connectors are used to connect the Jumpers to the feeders.
4. Accessories – These are the products which are used to connect feeder cable to the tower and to protect against lightning.

categories.name: Air Co
categories.definition:
A/C is meant to keep the temperature of a BTS or a remote node within predefined values. Two different types of A/C are in use in Vodafone:
1. Comfort Systems – Lower CapEx but higher OpEx. Comfort systems don’t come with the “free cooling” feature
2. Precision Systems – Higher CapEx but lower OpEx resulting from energy savings. These systems are preferred under TCO consideration

categories.name: Enclosures, Containers, Shelter

It provides covering and protection from external influences (e.g. weather, unauthorized access, vandalism, etc.)

categories.name: Fall Protection Systems
categories.definition:
The system which protects workers and technician if they were to fall from heights. The system contains in some cases a ladder, in others the ladder is part of the tower steel structure. There are systems with rails or cables in the market.
Additionally there is the Personal Equipment (PPE) with each climber that belongs as well to the Fall Protection System. It usually contains a Device/Fall Arrester, a Full Body Harness, a Rescue/Descender Device, a Safety Lanyard with integrated Shock Absorber and a Work positioning Lanyard with Rope Shortener.
